HRA Analysis: BLACKJACK SAM (5) was an impressive winner last time out when leading and holding off the late challenge of Blackjack who secured a good run close to the speed. He looks set to do it tough this time outside the leader but should find this a touch easier than his latest outing. FIT AND READY (4) got back in the run last time out and was running on nicely late not beaten far by Mullum Showgirl. She should settle close enough in the small field and can be running on well late with the right run. SWEET TIMES (3) has gate speed and will likely look to press through and lead in this race. He showed enough gate speed to lead in his latest start at Redcliffe when taking them all the way and rating good enough time for the grade. MEDELLIN (6) was able to sit without cover recently at Redcliffe and proved too good there in what was seemingly an easier race beating Aunty Mel. He draws poorly in this race outside the front row and will likely need a few things to go his way to win. SELECTIONS: BLACKJACK SAM (5), FIT AND READY (4), SWEET TIMES (3), MEDELLIN (6) SUGGESTED BET: BLACKJACK SAM (5) to win.

WHY TANYA SUE (7) trialled up nicely recently in a trial taken out by pacer Majorita Jujon. She has very good ability and if she can bring her best manners on return she should be hard to beat. BLACK VIPER (11) got back in the run last time out and was running on nicely late into second behind Buster Dan. He seems to do his best work when sat up and saved for one run and should be running on late again in this race. NONIS GOLD CLASS (9) made a break early last time out and took no competitive part there. She lands a similar race and looks well placed if she bring her best manners. ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (4) sat without cover last time out and battled away well there for third behind Buster Dan who has been in excellent form. She should secure a good run and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: WHY TANYA SUE (7), BLACK VIPER (11), NONIS GOLD CLASS (9), ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (4) SUGGESTED BET: WHY TANYA SUE (7) to win.

BLACKJACK (10) secured a good run last time out and was attacking the line well late to be narrowly beaten by Blackjack Sam. He should secure a good run off the speed in this race and looks very hard to beat second up in the state. CAMERINA (8) was forced to race without cover last time out and was just run down late by Our Sweet Jess who secured the perfect run on her back. She draws awkwardly inside the back row in this race and will need luck at the right time to get into the clear. TWIN CITIES (9) led last time out and was able to win an easier race. This looks a lot tougher but she did take on a similar race three starts ago and wasn’t beaten far in third there. FRANCO NOT OUT (4) did plenty wrong on debut in QLD when fading out of it late in a strong race behind Ruggards Gee Tee. He has since trialled just fairly and may be worth watching until he shows a touch more. SELECTIONS: BLACKJACK (10), CAMERINA (8), TWIN CITIES (9), FRANCO NOT OUT (4) SUGGESTED BET: BLACKJACK (10) to win.

TORO LOCO (7) was left without cover two starts ago and put in a big run there when finishing second not beaten far behind Goodoldboysandbeer who has since run well. He should be able to press forward and find a prominent position in this race and should run well again. GIRL POWER (3) was a good winner two starts ago at this track when finding the front and taking them all the way over the 2138. She draws to advantage over a number of her key rivals and if she could find the lead again would likely be hard to run down. ULTIMATE ARK (8) draws awkwardly inside the back row but does appear well suited in this company. He was running on nicely late last time out in a race taken out by Longshot. MAYWYN VALENTINO (9) didn’t have a lot of luck when getting back and running on last time out into sixth behind Longshot. He should get a good run off the speed and can be running on late again. SELECTIONS: TORO LOCO (7), GIRL POWER (3), ULTIMATE ARK (8), MAYWYN VALENTINO (9) SUGGESTED BET: TORO LOCO (7) to win.

PLAYING FOR KEEPS (2) led two starts ago and was run down late by Rocky Outlook who has since won again. She was left to do the work last time out when sitting outside of Erasmus and running well for second. She appears likely to be able to lead this time and should be hard to run down in this company. MAJOR SLIP UP (4) was shuffled back last time out at Marburg after drawing awkwardly inside the back row. He looks well graded in a race of this nature and is a horse which is capable of being driven to the speed of the race in this type of race. ROSIE POLLEN (8) led recently at this track and was just out stayed by Deep Regret who sat outside of her and proved too good. She draws awkwardly inside the back row behind a horse which doesn’t possess a lot of gate speed and will need luck at the right time. THREE CHORD RIFF (1) should secure a good run close to the speed in this race. She seems to lack change up speed but should be thereabouts in this race if it happens to be genuinely run. SELECTIONS: PLAYING FOR KEEPS (2), MAJOR SLIP UP (4), ROSIE POLLEN (8), THREE CHORD RIFF (1) SUGGESTED BET: PLAYING FOR KEEPS (2) to win.

SPLASHNDASH (4) was able to lead last time out and rolled along a strong tempo before just being run down late by Glenledi Boy who had the perfect run on his back. If he can work across to the lead in this race he should be hard to run down. STILLYOURSHOT (6) was forced to race without cover last time out at Redcliffe and was well beaten there behind Merry Jewel. If he can recapture some of his better form this race appears quite suitable. ALWAYS ADORNED (10) was running on nicely last time out into third at Redcliffe behind Nitrator. She had a few issues moving up to the gate in a recent at race at this track which saw her become a late scratching. Her best is good enough. LULU LUCIFER (1) has a good draw in this race to settle close in the run. She was able to secure a good run last time out 3 back on the pegs and was running on late into third behind Glenledi Boy. SELECTIONS: SPLASHNDASH (4), STILLYOURSHOT (6), ALWAYS ADORNED (10), LULU LUCIFER (1) SUGGESTED BET: ALWAYS ADORNED (10) to win.

SHADES OF MIKI (7) made a break early last time out before locking wheels which essentially ended his winning chances in that race. He had been terrific in two runs for the stable running two nice seconds having done the work in the run and can do the work again in this race and looks hard to beat. RUBY RHAYNE BOW (3) didn’t have things go her way last time out when left without cover in a race taken out by Miss Bay King Cole where she battled on reasonably for fourth. She looks the likely leader this time and can run well from there. MISTER MANAGER (9) was a nice winner three starts ago sitting close to the speed and sprinting best late to score. He should get a similar type of run in this race and can be running on late again. LOCH LAMOND (1) was able to secure a good run off the speed recently at this track and trip before sprinting over the top to score nicely. He steps up in grade but draws nicely and should run another good race. SELECTIONS: SHADES OF MIKI (7),RUBY RHAYNE BOW (3), MISTER MANAGER (9), LOCH LAMOND (1) SUGGESTED BET: SHADES OF MIKI (7) to win.

LONGSHOT (7) was very impressive last time out doing plenty of work and proving too good rallying strongly up the home straight to win. He finds a similar race and should be able to work forward and find a prominent position again in this race. WEHAVTIME (6) was shuffled back last time out before attacking the line powerfully late finishing a close up second to Deep Regret. He should get a good run off the speed again and can be running on late. CHARLIE CHUCKLES (5) was taken on throughout last time out at Marburg before being run down late by Taylors Four who had the perfect run on the leaders back. He can press forward in this race and find a prominent position. MAYWYNS ACE (9) was shuffled back last time out over the 1660 at this track before running on well into fourth behind Deep Regret. He should get a good run off the speed and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: LONGSHOT (7), WEHAVTIME (6), CHARLIE CHUCKLES (5), MAYWYNS ACE (9) SUGGESTED BET: LONGSHOT (7) to win.

NORTHVIEW CRUNCHA (9) has shown promise since joining the stable of Al Barnes with two good wins before finishing second last time out when seemingly out sprinted over the concluding stages. He should get a good run early and can settle close enough to figure in the finish again. ROCKIN IN PARADISE (2) led four starts ago over the 2040 at Redcliffe when badly over racing and just fading into third late but was still able to rate fast time for his own mile rate. If he can lead again in this race he is likely to take some running down. FIGHT FOR VICTORY (10) got back off the speed and made a wide run into it last time out when finishing a close up second behind All Eyes On Bling. He may get back again from the back row draw and can be running on strongly late. LLANFAIR LEWELLAN (4) secured a good run last time out on the pegs and was running on late into fourth in a race taken out by Bettor Cheer. He draws a touch awkwardly but looks suited in this race. SELECTIONS: NORTHVIEW CRUNCHA (9), ROCKIN IN PARADISE (2), FIGHT FOR VICTORY (10), LLANFAIR LEWELLAN (4) SUGGESTED BET: ROCKIN IN PARADISE (2) to win. FLYING COLOURS (3) draws the best of the main chances in this race and may be able to work to the lead in the early stages of the race which would likely see him quite hard to beat. He led four starts ago and looked the winner there 200 to go before being run down by Fifty Three Stars. STARZZZ DESTINY (7) draws poorly outside the front row and looks to be forced to do some work in the run. He secured a good run last time out and was able to run on late into third past one of his key rivals in this race SPUNKYS GOTSECRETS (8). BETTOR CHEER (9) was a very impressive winner last time out after sitting behind the leader he dashed up sharply and won by a big margin over his stablemate Next To Me. He should get a good run off the speed can be running on strongly late. SPUNKYS GOTSECRETS (8) was asked to apply pressure to the leader a long way from home last time out before fading into fourth when getting tired late in the race. He should secure a more economical run this time and looks hard to beat with luck in running. SELECTIONS: FLYING COLOURS (3), STARZZZ DESTINY (7), BETTOR CHEER (9), SPUNKYS GOTSECRETS (8) SUGGESTED BET: FLYING COLOURS (3) to win.

KING BOBBIE (1) should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race from an ideal draw. He was able to drive through and lead recently at this track before being run down late by Francs For Coming. He looks the one to beat. JOHN WAYNE (6) secured a good run close to the speed last time out and just couldn’t quite get into second late when finishing alongside Next To Me over the 2138 at this track. He draws poorly in this race and may be forced to do some work at some stage. ANTETOKOUNMPO (8) looks set to get the ideal run through early in this race from a good draw. He drew the back line recently at Newcastle and was running on into third behind Rainbow Jet. He comes into this race third up and should be nearing peak fitness. NEXT TO ME (4) led recently at this track and was well beaten in second by his stablemate Bettor Cheer. He should settle close enough in this race from a good draw and can be running on late this time. SELECTIONS: KING BOBBIE (1), JOHN WAYNE (6), ANTETOKOUNMPO (8), NEXT TO ME (4) SUGGESTED BET: KING BOBBIE (1) to win.

AIR EXPRESS (4) given how the race was run and the fact he was left outside the leader off the pegs he appeared to have a near impossible task getting into the placings. He was able to run a brilliant last half to run by DOUGS FLAME (8) into third finishing close up behind Smarter Than You and Bainbridge. He may be left without cover in this race but off his latest outing he should still be very hard to beat. MOSSDALE TERRY (2) has very good gate speed and should be able to work to the early lead before having options from there. He got back in the run last time out and was running on nicely late into fifth behind Smarter Than You. He should get every chance. DOUGS FLAME (8) appeared to have every chance last time out to finish in third and just couldn’t quite hold off AIR EXPRESS (4) late settling for fourth. He should get a suitable run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. EXCLUSIVE HUSTLER (7) draws poorly in this race outside the front row. He was very good two starts ago running third behind Catseye Beach in fast time at this track over the 1660. He should run well again. SELECTIONS: AIR EXPRESS (4), MOSSDALE TERRY (2), DOUGS FLAME (8), EXCLUSIVE HUSTLER (7) SUGGESTED BET: AIR EXPRESS (4) to win.

PINNIE (10) was very good last time out running on late into third in a race the winner Golden Sunset dashed up a brilliant last half over the mile for the trotters. She faces a 20m handicap in this race but is a mare with a nice turn of foot and if she can settle close enough early should be running on strongly late. MAJESTIC LAVROS (2) is a speedy horse that could be well suited I this race settling close to the speed and running on late off the front handicap. He secured a good run close to the speed last time out and was running on late into second behind KODA DA MODA (1). If he can settle close on the pegs he could play a part in the finish. KODA DA MODA (1) found the front last time out and didn’t break any records winning in just moderate time but did dash up nicely late and won quite comfortably. She looks well suited from a favourable handicap in this race and if she was able to lead would prove hard to run down in a race of this nature. GET USED TO IT (9) trialled up nicely recently behind smart pacer Always B Cool from the standing start at Albion Park over this same trip. If he can step away well he looks a good chance of playing a big part in the finish off the 20m handicap in this race. SELECTIONS: PINNIE (10),MAJESTIC LAVROS (2), KODA DA MODA (1), GET USED TO IT (9) SUGGESTED BET: MAJESTIC LAVROS (2) each way.

OUR SWEET JESS (3) was able to secure the ideal run close to the speed last time out before running over the top to beat Camerina at this track rating fast time. She finds a similar type of race and should be able to find a prominent position from a good draw. SHES IN LINE (2) was forced to do plenty of work last time out before eventually finding the front at this track over the 2138 and battled on nicely for third not beaten far. She has good gate speed and appears to find a race where she may be able to work to the lead again which should see her hard to beat. VINNIE NITRO (1) appears likely to get a great run just behind the speed in this race. She ran a good second two starts ago after securing a similar run to the one she is likely to get in this race in a race which was taken out by Golden Shooz. SPORTY ZARA (8) should get a good run through early in this race and should be close enough on the pegs. She secured a similar run to the one she is likely to receive in this race two starts ago when running over the top late over the 2280 at Redcliffe beating Stormtide. SELECTIONS: OUR SWEET JESS (3), SHES IN LINE (2), VINNIE NITRO (1), SPORTY ZARA (8) SUGGESTED BET: SHES IN LINE (2) to win.

CAPTAIN SHUFFLES (5) was terrific in a trial prior to resuming when rating fast time and appearing to do it with relative ease. He then was able to lead on return showing brilliant gate speed and ran an excellent race leading when finishing second to the superstar Leap To Fame. He should be able to work across to the lead again and should be winning if he can repeat his first up effort. TIGER BAND WAGON (2) trialled well prior to resuming finishing second behind Dashing who has come out and won before running second to Leap To Fame since the trial. He secured a good run on return and was running on fairly late into fourth. He is likely to have derived benefit from the outing and should be suited by a step back to the shorter 1660 trip. DISTRICT ATTORNEY (1) has a good draw in this race and should get a soft run just behind the speed. He raced without luck last time out when attempting to cross early before being shuffled back and had to settle for sixth there. He should get a lot more favours this time. TIMS A TROOPER (6) didn’t seem to possess his usual dash when struggling to go with the runner up behind his champion stablemate Leap To Fame in Dashing. He draws poorly in this race and will likely need the race run to suit to bring him into the race. SELECTIONS: CAPTAIN SHUFFLES (5), TIGER BAND WAGON (2), DISTRICT ATTORNEY (1), TIMS A TROOPER (6) SUGGESTED BET: TIGER BAND WAGON (2) to place.

COOL AND CLASSY (2) has options in the early stages of this race from a good draw whether she elects to tuck in behind the potential leader SALLY BIGTIME (1) or stay in the running line. She had an excellent carnival which included breaking the track record for 1780 at Redcliffe before taking out The Queensland Sun her following start. She looks hard to beat on return. SALLY BIGTIME (1) has the good draw in this race and can look to drive through and lead in the early stages of the race. She was able to lead all the way holding off Golden Fire three starts ago at this track and trip. If she can control things out in front she can prove hard to beat. RUBY RULES (4) will be looking for a hat-trick of wins on return in this race. She was able to lead her latest start beating stablemate Reds Ablaze and one of the likely favourites in this race COOL AND CLASSY (2). She draws a touch awkwardly and may need the race run to suit to bring her into contention. TREMENDOUS SENSATION (5) has excellent gate speed and may look to press forward in this race and find a prominent position. She led last time out and was just run down late by Seaside Glory who secured a good run in the race. SELECTIONS: COOL AND CLASSY (2), SALLY BIGTIME (1), RUBY RULES (4), TREMENDOUS SENSATION (5) SUGGESTED BET: COOL AND CLASSY (2) to win.

SHES CRUNCHY (7) trialled up smartly behind Fire And Passion when not beaten far in a very slick last half of 27.9, 26.3. She draws poorly in this race but has shown she is capable of doing work in her races and still fighting out the finish. She should go close. MAHINDI (4) secured a good run off the speed last time out at Redcliffe before running on strongly and scoring a huge win rating good time there. She steps right up in grade but draws well enough on the front row and should settle close enough to play a big part in the finish. GOLDEN SHOOZ (6) has an awkward draw in this race and may be shuffled back or forced to do some work. She sat without cover in a much stronger race taken out by Mostert at this track and trip. She should find this easier. MISS FROUFROU (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race before having options. She was able to bounce back to form last time out when leading and winning at Redcliffe. SELECTIONS: SHES CRUNCHY (7), MAHINDI (4), GOLDEN SHOOZ (6), MISS FROUFROU (1) SUGGESTED BET: MAHINDI (4) to win.

RACE FOR RICHES (7) got back last time out and was running on strongly late in a strong race taken out by Dragon at this track. He finds a race which could generate a good tempo and allow him to be running into it late again. CALL IT BLING (3) was an impressive winner rating good time at this track and trip in the consolation of the QBRED Triad series for the 3YO colts and geldings. He should settle close from a favourable front row draw. If he was able to lead he would take plenty of running down. BENNYDASOOK (4) drew poorly first up from a spell last time out and was running on strongly late into third behind All Eyes On Bling. He should settle a lot closer this time and will be hard to hold out late. KING BLING (1) has moderate gate speed and may be keen to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race from the good draw. He was a good winner four starts ago finishing best to get over the top late. SELECTIONS: RACE FOR RICHES (7), CALL IT BLING (3), BENNYDASOOK (4), KING BLING (1) SUGGESTED BET: RACE FOR RICHES (7) to win. TWILIGHT STORM (1) gets back to the pole draw, where she is two from two in her career. She should have enough gate speed to kick up early and hold the front, giving her every chance to notch another win on the board. REMMINGTON (7) beat the above runner last start when able to lead and has been racing in good form. He will have to do it tougher here from the wide draw and find a spot on speed, but you can't knock winning form and he looks the main danger. SUMTHIN ELSE (2) should drop in behind the polemarker and get its chance up the sprint lane after putting in a handy enough effort first up in the state. COUNT YOUR BLESSIN (4) and MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (5) returned to form with handy efforts last start, although this looks a slight rise in grade, so they may require a couple of the favoured runners to get into a battle to be finishing past them. Selections:TWILIGHT STORM (1), REMMINGTON (7), SUMTHIN ELSE (2), COUNT YOUR BLESSIN (4)

An even field of two-year-olds comes together for the No More Than One Win event, where DARCY BE DREAMING (9) returns from a good break after winning on debut earlier this season. He has trialled up nicely enough and, with a handy trailing back-row draw behind what looks a good beginner, should be able to position somewhere midfield in the running line and be running home strongly. MYSTERY MAIL (10) has produced some very strong performances while doing work in fast time throughout his career to date. While he still looks to be learning how to race, he appears to have plenty of ability and will only need to put his best foot forward to be running home strongly here. STABLE TALK (8) showed good promise in his first preparation and should be right in the finish if the gaps come his way from the inside back-row draw. ANN PENNY (2) is first up from New Zealand after some competitive efforts in metropolitan company. Her trials since arriving in the state have been good enough to suggest she could take some running down if able to find the pegs, where she looks to possess sharp gate speed when asked. HEZA PINUP BOY (4) and VINCENT THE THIRD (5) look to have some ability, although both strike awkward draws here. BETTOR CALL LOU (6) has put together some nice trial efforts since his debut run, where he broke, and could be the one at odds from the wide draw if he can secure a good run in transit. Selections:ANN PENNY (2), MYSTERY MAIL (10), DARCY BE DREAMING (9), STABLE TALK (8)

OMYBACNKNEES JUDGE (1) draws the pole over the mile and, with his handy gate speed coming off a strong performance last start, you would expect he could take some running down in this field. He may cop some early pressure from COLORADO GIRL (7), who possesses very sharp gate speed when asked, but the remainder of the front row only look to have moderate gate speed. A ROCKN NIGHTMARE (3) has been okay since arriving in the state and, if she is able to settle better than she did last start, she should be right in the finish. The remainder of the field is an even bunch, where QUEEN ANASTASIA (2) has been somewhat disappointing this season after putting together some nice placings in feature races last year. If she brings her best form from the nice draw, she could be the one at each-way odds running over the top late. Selections:OMYBACNKNEES JUDGE (1), QUEEN ANASTASIA (2), A ROCKN NIGHTMARE (3), COLORADO GIRL (7)

The second division of the No More Than One Win horses is over the mile, where WINNING BREW (3) will be looking to get back into the winner's circle after some handy performances of late against somewhat stronger fields than she meets here. Expect him to be driven forward from the gate and attempt to find the pegs, although GEMMY LOU (1) does possess sharp gate speed when required. She resumes first up for the new stable and should also be suited by the short-distance journey. COMINSKI LEIS (5) looks an improving type, and his last effort two months ago, when doing the work outside the leader and battling on for fourth against a very strong field, would be good enough to take this out if fit enough first up from the let-up. It wouldn't surprise to see any of the runners in this field bob up and win with the right run in transit, including TISU SUNNY (6) who is more than capable if he bring his best manners. Selections:WINNING BREW (3), COMINSKI LEIS (5), TISU SUNNY (6), GEMMY LOU (1)

ALOT LIKE PENDLES (1) resumes from nearly five months off and draws the pole for his return. He is clearly the most progressive horse in this field and should be fit enough after a strong recent trial in preparation for his return. OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (4) won well first up in the state when leading over the mile. There looks to be some okay gate speed drawn to her inside today, so her chances may be reliant on where she is able to settle in the run, but she looks the main danger to the expected favourite. COUNTY COURT JUDGE (2) is first up in the state and, prior to his Tamworth racing, had some handy Queensland and New South Wales form that would make him more than competitive here from the nice draw. CHEYS ANGEL (7) is going for three straight and has been quite impressive in both wins since rejoining her old camp. She will be relying on some good speed throughout and a nice cart into the race to allow her to finish strongly again. KENYA (10) continues to run honest races and will no doubt be put into the race from the back row, which should ensure an even tempo throughout. Selections:ALOT LIKE PENDLES (1), OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (4), COUNTY COURT JUDGE (2), CHEYS ANGEL (7)

The low-class race tonight as usual brings together an even bunch, where KYRGIOS (5) will be looking to find a spot on speed after a strong performance last week when second after copping pressure through a 27.3 first quarter. QUEENOFDANCE (12) is going for three straight victories and will be reliant on some good speed throughout to allow her to run home strongly again here. DANCINGWIVJOLENE (2) should be fitter second up from a break and gets the ideal draw to sit on speed and get her chance to be in the finish, as does BARBETTE (3), who is consistently earning cheques in this grade without winning often and should use her handy gate speed to also find a spot on speed. It wouldn't surprise to see any of the other runners in the field bob up and win with the right run in transit. Selections:KYRGOIS (5), QUEENOFDANCE (12), DANCINGWIVJOLENE (2), BARBETTE (3)

The front row has numerous runners with solid gate speed but no clear standout, making this a tricky map to assess. ROCKY STRIDE (5) continues to run great races without winning but again draws an awkward gate. IDEN OLIVER (1) and ART HUNTSMAN (4) have the winning form on the board and continue to rise in grade, but should land nice positions on speed from their handy draws, as should MERRYWOOD PAUL (2) who has been thereabouts of late without winning. GOODTIME OSCAR (6) will no doubt be put into the race at some point, as he usually is, which should ensure a solid tempo throughout. The back-row runners will be relying on that speed up front to allow them to run home strongly, including UNMATCHED (8), who draws a tricky gate but could be flashing home late if the gaps come his way after being super competitive in the recent Raider Stakes Final and Beautide field. Selections:UNMATCHED (8), ROCKY STRIDE (5), IDEN OLIVER (1), ART HUNTSMAN (4)

TREACHEROUS DAN (1) is a three-year-old resuming from a slight let-up and looks a promising type. However, the pole draw is probably the one he didn't want, especially with some handy gate-speed horses in SHADES OF SILK (2) and LAID BACK (5) drawn to his outside. Even if he doesn't hold the front, as I suspect, you would think he gets his chance up the sprint lane and should be right in the finish. RAINBOW RANGER (4) is another handy three-year-old who will be looking to find a nice spot on speed with cover, which should give him every chance first up from a break. MUZZAME MATE (6) draws an awkward gate over the short distance, so tactics will be interesting early, but you can't discount his class. It is hard to see the back-row runners beating the favoured front-row horses unless they overdo it early, which would bring the likes of IDEN LADY LINCOLN (10) and SHOOBEES SPIRIT (12) into the race late. Selections:RAINBOW RANGER (4), TREACHEROUS DAN (1), MUZZAME MATE (6), SHADES OF SILK (2)

The open-class field of the night, where WATERMELON SUGAR (1) will again be looking for an all-the-way victory using his sharp gate speed. Expect WAVES OF CHANCE (4) to push forward from his middle front-row draw and sit on speed, while HORATIUS SPECULO (3) should look to land on his back and secure the ideal one-one position, giving him every chance to sprint quickly late. MAEBEE (8) was back in the winner's circle last week with a strong performance and should get a nice cushy run behind the expected leader, giving him his chance up the sprint lane if he can repeat that effort. GO THE RED (6) looks the best of the rest and will be relying on some solid tempo throughout to allow him to run home into the finish from his awkward draw. Selections:HORATIUS SPECULO (3), MAEBEE (8), WAVES OF CHANCE (4), WATERMELON SUGAR (1)

The night rounds out with a stand-start event over the long distance, where MOVESLIKEALADY (1) has her first attempt behind the tapes. She began brilliantly in a trial at Carrick earlier in the week and, although she is known to be quite a handful from the mobiles, hopefully it may be the opposite here. A safe beginning will take her a long way in this field. SAPPHIRE GAMBLER (2) is a sharp beginner and should get his chance, although this is stronger than what he has been competing against lately. WE SALUTE YOU (6) is always running home strongly in these sorts of fields, while BAIL DENIED (7) also has his first stand-start attempt but has been in super form since arriving in the state. If he steps safely away, as he did when qualifying at the trials, he could take some holding out late. UP THE BOMBER (3) is drawn well and has shown some nice ability at the trials. If he can find the lead early he will be hard to catch. ANGRYPANTS ANGIE (6) is a big threat as well and has also been showing ability at the trials. JUST MILZY (5) and IMNOLOVEANBUSINESS (1) are also chances.

JILLIBY BLISS (3) was narrowly beaten at Kapunda last start off a twenty meter handicap. She will prefer being back here at Globe Derby today along with the mobile start. She is a good chance of leading all of the way. EMILY MEGAN (5), MAGICAL MADGE (2) and REHAB LAD (1) are also chances.

OHSO KINKY (7) has a tough draw to overcome but she can win over this distance. She ran a handy race first up last week and she looks like a strong winning chance today. JAWSOFGOODTIME (2) should find the lead today and run a strong race but the distance will be a concern for her. TRIGGER (4) and MANDS PEARL (3) are also chances.

RESURRECTS (3) ran a very nice race behind ROCKNROLL SPIRIT last start when he was beaten by a short half head. He is a strong chance today in a race like this. LINXX (6), TWO WAY WONDER (2) and UPRIGHT (1) are also chances.

STORMY MADEM (7) was a galloper last start but if she can pace smoothly today for Ryan Hryhorec then she finds such a winnable race if she is anywhere near her best. OAKLANDER (6) is drawn awkwardly but he is another who could run a very strong race today if he is anywhere near his best. BERSAGLIERE (3) and MY ULTIMATE BANJO (1) are also chances.

JACKIE DANIELS (4) ran fourth at Globe Derby last start and third at Gawler the start prior. She has the ability to take this sort of race out if she is anywhere near her best. Today looks easier for her. ROAD STAR (8), PARADIGM (2) and MIKISPUR (3) are also chances.

BITOFDUTCHCOURAGE (1) gets the best draw he has had for a while. If he leads then he should lead all of the way. ALWAYSBEALADY (5) looks like a big threat after a strong win at Globe Derby last start when she defeated TONKAWAIKON by a half head. FLY THE BANNER (9) and DEE JAYS MISS (4) are also chances.

SRIRACHA (9) was a massive winner at Kapunda last start when he defeated JUST MOCHA by 25.5 meters. He looks extremely hard to beat today even with the second row draw. FEARFULL DRAGON (4), RIVERGUM VELOX (3) and PARISIAN BANDIT (1) are also chances.

LOCHINVAR RULER (11) was very impressive last start when he led all of the way and defeated BRUZER by 8.3 meters. If he gains a start as the first emergency today then he will be hard to beat. DASHING COWBOY (2), BRUZER (10), CAPTAINS DREAM (1) and GIANT JACKSON (6) are all big chances in what is a very tricky race. OVERVIEW:REGAL GALA (1) has enjoyed a terrific season having won four races. He followed a handy second in the Super Series Final with a win in the Tatlow Stakes so he will prove hard to beat. PHOENIX REX (5) produced a phenomenal performance after being severely checked on the first bend and coming from tailed off to win the Qbred Triad Final at Albion Park. He hasn’t been at his best form in two starts since returning to Victoria but he is extremely smart when he puts it altogether and he is the only horse in this race that has competed from the standing start previously. MAJARO GIRL (8) showed brilliant gate speed to lead, took cover and tried hard when second in the Tatlow Stakes last outing. She was a dominant winner in a mile rate of 1.58.8 at Melton prior and is worth an investment. KYVALLEY DIXON (6) produced a big finish to claim victory in the Super Series Final two starts ago prior to a fourth in the Tatlow Stakes. She is a classy filly and must be respected. INSULATOR (2) jumped to the front from the standing start when he won a trial at Melton on Tuesday so he rates as a value hope. SELECTIONS: REGAL GALA (1), PHOENIX REX (5), MAJARO GIRL (8), KYVALLEY DIXON (6)

OVERVIEW:MYDEEPESTDESIRE (7) has done very well at her two starts to date and deserves to break through for a win. She raced without cover throughout and went down fighting when a close second at Ballarat on debut then held her own in a fast final quarter of 27.9 seconds at her latest third. CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (6) began very quickly from a similar wide draw to find the lead when a close second behind Tombeur at Cranbourne last outing. He has been runner up in five of his seven starts to date and should give another forward showing. SWIM SUIT (8) was resuming since April when he worked home fairly well for fourth at Horsham on Monday. He should be fitter from that performance and is capable of running into a place. AMADA VILLMA (9) missed out narrowly after trying to lead throughout at Charlton two starts ago and has claims. The former New South Wales pacer KELLYS COMMOTION (10) was heavily supported but galloped when on debut at Newcastle so she must be kept safe. BACK: MYDEEPESTDESIRE (7) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: MYDEEPESTDESIRE (7), CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (6), SWIM SUIT (8), AMADA VILLMA (9)

OVERVIEW: BETSY ANNE (6) possesses early speed and strikes a very suitable assignment here. She trailed the leader, was held up for a run at a vital stage and worked into third via the sprint lane at Kilmore last outing. TOUCHANDGO (5) didn’t have much luck when seventh at Ballarat last outing but his two efforts prior were sound and he is worth thought under these conditions. MISS AVENGER (2) settled on the markers, angled out three horses wide from the 600m and ran home fairly well for fourth when resuming at Kilmore. She should be fitter from that run and is worth a ticket each way. WHATSTHEGOSS (10) is a maiden from 31 starts but he has the ability to win races if he can mend his manners. He finished off well via an inside run when third at Ballarat two starts ago and could feature prominently if he delivers a fool proof display. BACK: BETSY ANNE (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: BETSY ANNE (6), TOUCHANDGO (5), MISS AVENGER (2), WHATSTHEGOSS (10)

OVERVIEW: CASTLES IN THE SKY (7) was having her first run since February without going to the trials when she attempted to lead throughout and battled on well for third behind Connies President at Horsham on Monday. She should have derived a lot of benefit from that run and is a good chance of working across with NEDZA THRILLER (6) early before finding the top shortly afterwards so she must be included amongst the leading chances. NEDZA THRILLER (6) led out then took cover when second behind the in-form trotter Boutika at Charlton then attempted to lead throughout when second at Ballarat. He appears to be the fastest beginner on the front line and should give another bold showing. ALLWATFUNJINGLES (10) has been finding the line nicely at his most recent performances and strikes a suitable assignment now so he warrants consideration. CHARLIE WALKER (8) performed below expectations when sixth behind Money Talks at Kilmore last outing but he led throughout at a Ballarat victory on September 02 so he is worth another chance. SELECTIONS: CASTLES IN THE SKY (7), NEDZA THRILLER (6), ALLWATFUNJINGLES (10), CHARLIE WALKER (8)

OVERVIEW: The manners of PURPLE MOON (6) will be the key to the result of this event. She galloped away and made up many lengths when a huge second behind Joe Lou three starts ago then broke stride at her next two attempts. She is clearly the horse to beat if she delivers a fool proof display. THE CHOOK (7) settled in the second half of the field and worked home well when second behind Aldebaran Denbay last outing. She is usually competitive against this class and looms as one of the leading chances again. CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (4) did well to score at Ballarat last outing after she parked on the outside of the leader throughout. She is likely to obtain a prominent position in the early stages and is worth thought again. SNICKERS EXPRESS (3) has been placed in six of his past seven starts and deserves to break through for a win. He did appear to have his chance when third at Ballarat last time out but this race is no harder so he is worth a ticket each way. SELECTIONS: PURPLE MOON (6), THE CHOOK (7), CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (4), SNICKERS EXPRESS (3)

OVERVIEW:ANTONOV (11) faces the back mark of 20m but he is a standing start specialist and is very versatile. He followed successive Maryborough victories with a sixth against strong opposition in the Geelong Cup last outing. NEPHEW OF SONOKO (10) ran a much sharper race when he dashed through the middle late and finished in fourth at Cranbourne last week. He has only been placed once this season but his last run was encouraging and this is his easiest assignment for some time. CHAMPAGNE CHARLEY (3) has commenced from big handicaps at his past two attempts and has performed strongly. He moves to the front line now and must be respected. BOUTIKA (1) continues to step up in grade but she has never raced better and is drawn to receive every chance. She pushed forward to find the lead and scored comfortably in a standing start event at Charlton last outing. SELECTIONS: ANTONOV (11), NEPHEW OF SONOKO (10), CHAMPAGNE CHARLEY (3), BOUTIKA (1)

OVERVIEW: ASMILEANDAWINX (10) prefers to race close to the speed so the barrier draw is a disadvantage but she is clearly the class runner of the field. She competed in a Metropolitan event when fifth at Geelong last week and she recorded mile rates of 1.55.1 and 1.55.7 in two recent Maryborough victories. ASSIGNED (9) worked to the front, backed off the tempo mid-race and finished off in slick final sectionals when he won at Kilmore on September 17. He took on a strong field at Shepparton last time out and appears to be much better placed against this class. ARTIST (2) is a brilliant beginner and is the likely leader. He worked hard to lead from a wide draw and had excuses at Ballarat last outing so he is worth another chance. ANIMADO (6) was placed at Melton behind Hiltons Spirit on September 09 and is better than his numerical form suggests. He is a possible improver under these conditions. SELECTIONS: ASMILEANDAWINX (10), ASSIGNED (9), ARTIST (2), ANIMADO (6)

OVERVIEW: RANGER RICK (9), is a consistent pacer, which missed out narrowly behind Keayang Payton at Geelong two starts ago and followed with a fourth at Geelong, where he led out, took cover and was shuffled back on the markers. This event appears to be easier and he should run his usual honest race. STEEL THE MOMENT (6) was resuming since July when he was headed off at the start and was buried away on the markers at his latest handy finishing sixth behind Ultimate Vinnie. He should have benefited from that run and strikes a suitable assignment here. IMAGINATION ORO (2) progressed forward to find the lead and dominated her rivals when she scored in a mile rate of 1.56.3 at Terang. She is meeting a field of more depth now but she is drawn to give another forward showing. KATUNGA EXPRESS (8) will need luck from the inside of the second line but he ran a game race for third at Ballarat last week and is not without a chance. BACK: RANGER RICK (9) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: RANGER RICK (9), STEEL THE MOMENT (6), IMAGINATION ORO (2), KATUNGA EXPRESS (8)

OVERVIEW: JUSTLIKEDAVE (7) got a long way back from a similar wide draw and finished off hard when third behind Roblen Demon at Cranbourne last week. He was driven aggressively mid-race and put in a career best performance when a runaway winner at Cranbourne three starts ago and he looms as one of the leading chances again. TORQUE IN HEAVEN (6) is racing in peak form and should be competitive again. He has been defeated by Yankee Rain at his past two runner up performances but both times he finished strongly so he is capable of going one better here. TED BEAR (10) settled in the second half of the field and finished off solidly when second behind Our Pinup Girl in a mile rate of 1.55.7 at Ballarat last outing. He is starting to hit his peak form and should be finishing off nicely again. REGAL ROCK (4) is a fast beginner and races best when he is able to lead over the sprint distance so he has the conditions to suit him here. He pushed forward to find the lead and was run down over the final stages when third behind Wingate Guy last outing. BACK: JUSTLIKEDAVE (7) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: JUSTLIKEDAVE (7), TORQUE IN HEAVEN (6), TED BEAR (10), REGAL ROCK (4)

OVERVIEW: LOLLY (6) looks a bright prospect for trainer Bill Milner who strikes a very suitable two-year-old trot to break her maiden. First-up, she was only beaten 4.1m by the handy Kyvalley Drifter and then chased home Majaro Girl (has won again since) for a close-up second in a heat of the Vicbred Super Series before dropping out in the Group 1 final. I think there’s some nice ability there and happy her way. Fancied THECANDYBARHEIRESS (5) on debut last Friday following some good trials and she was a hard luck story for Kylie Sugars, who never really got clear air until it was all over. She hit the line hard for second behind The Trout Cod and looms as the key danger. SERIOUSLY SAL (7) ran a great second in the Vicbred consolation at Ballarat last time and wouldn’t shock, while DELIGHTED (3) is a stablemate of THECANDYBARHEIRESS (5) who has been okay at the trials ahead of her first race start. BACK: LOLLY (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: LOLLY (6), THECANDYBARHEIRESS (5), SERIOUSLY SAL (7), KACOON (1)

OVERVIEW: Awesome race and one where plenty can win, but we’ve got to land somewhere and that’s with the speedy little KARBINE (5). John Tormey has done a wonderful job with this pint-sized squaregaiter and he’s in arguably career-best form with two wins in his last four starts. The other two outings were slashing finales through the Vicbred Super Series heats and final. If he lands handy in the running line, he will be closing off hard. HOWDY MATE (6) won the Group 1 Vicbred final for three-year-old trotting boys last time out and must be a factor off the front row, IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (9) has enjoyed a great campaign, and like KARBINE (5), ran well for third in the Vicbred four-year-old boys’ decider, while NO MONEY NO HONEY (1) is a chance to be crossed by NAKEDTRUTH (2) but is very talented on her best manners and has won both times she’s trotted throughout this preparation. She heads a host of other winning hopes. SELECTIONS: KARBINE (5), HOWDY MATE (6), IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (9), NO MONEY NO HONEY (1)

OVERVIEW: Think he will go around decent odds HANDLER (10), but I’ve always liked this lightly-raced pacer from the Rob O’Connell yard. I reckon the first-up run was more than satisfactory from an impossible position on straightening in a stronger race than what he meets here and he only got beaten 10m under little driving. There looks genuine tempo with some go-forward horses off the front and I’m hoping he can be hitting the line hard late. POPCORNFRIDAY (8) draws behind one of the quick beginners in YNOBE NOVA (1) and was very good first-up from a break when second at Kilmore on September 30. He ran up dead ends a couple of times and closed hard to be beaten 7.4m. Key chance. CELESTIAL ZODIAC (7) has a horror gate but is running in great form and is rarely beaten far, while BRINGSUSJOY (3) was outclassed last weekend at Geelong but went very close at big odds in the Vicbred consolation for four-year-old mares prior to that. The chances don’t stop there and include JUST AS WELL (4), strong last-start winner BLAZIN BY (6) and ANGELS WATCHING (9). BACK: HANDLER (10) – 0.5 units (each-way) SELECTIONS: HANDLER (10), POPCORNFRIDAY (8), CELESTIAL ZODIAC (7), BRINGSUSJOY (3)

OVERVIEW: FREIGHT SHAKER (6) sat parked and was only nailed in the shadows of the post in a race five of these horses contested at Geelong last Saturday. It was a very brave effort second-up from a little freshen and followed a fourth behind CENTURION DREAM (10) at Melton prior to that. There looks speed aplenty off the front, but if he gets some luck in running and a nice trip, I fancy he’s ready to win. There’s stacks of other chances, though. KYVALLEY MICHAEL (11) will need the tempo to be genuine to work into things from his tricky draw but is going well, CENTURION DREAM (10) has won her last two but this is tougher from gate 10, while ALDEBARAN SUSANNE (7) led from wide on the front last weekend at Geelong and looked the winner turning for home but faded late. KEAYANG GYPSY (8) is perhaps the other leading contender, but really most could win without surprising. SELECTIONS: FREIGHT SHAKER (6), KYVALLEY MICHAEL (11), CENTURION DREAM (10), ALDEBARAN SUSANNE (7)

OVERVIEW: I CHOOSE YOU (2) was outclassed in the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series final for three-year-old trotting boys last time, but ran well for second behind the handy Munny The Munster in a heat and won easily first-up at Ballarat prior to that. He should be able to find the fence early and from there looks the testing material. TRUSCOTTS ELEGANCE (1) is really going well of late, chasing home Queen Of Sees in a heat and final of the Vicbred series for three-year-old trotting girls before a good closing second last week at Ballarat, LITTLE MISS MORGAN (8) returned to the winner’s stall when leading a suitable race at Kilmore last week and has plenty of class, while AGAINST THE BRIDLE (4) won three races on end before being held up and still finishing well for third last Friday behind Romantic Nina. DEEJAY DEX (10) hasn’t won since 2024 but is knocking on the door, RASTAMON (3) is a speedy customer who might give them something to catch in front, THATS MY CARDIGAN (7) is another that flies the gate and is capable at his best, while MAJESTIC CHARMA (11) won well at Cranbourne recently and also wouldn’t shock. SELECTIONS: I CHOOSE YOU (2), TRUSCOTTS ELEGANCE (1), LITTLE MISS MORGAN (8), AGAINST THE BRIDLE (4)

OVERVIEW: THUNDERFIRE (6) has been in great form this campaign, and it all started with a big death seat win first-up at Cranbourne on August 16. He was badly held up behind Scooter Lou following that, then ran a great second in a Vicbred heat and did well to only be beaten 13.2m from last in the $100,000 final. Map looks awkward for him, but fancy he’ll go close with some luck. He’s a good horse. POPPY WAH WAH (9) hasn’t raced since May 2025, but hails from the Emma Stewart stable and showed good ability with three victories last campaign. The recent trial was okay despite not beating a runner home. SAVON DE ROCHE (3) is in great form for Kate Hargreaves with wins or narrow defeats in all six runs this preparation, while FERRIGNO (4) performed well at good odds when third last Saturday at Geelong behind Schwarz and is another that looks ready to win. BACK: THUNDERFIRE (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: THUNDERFIRE (6), POPPY WAH WAH (9), SAVON DE ROCHE (3), FERRIGNO (4)

OVERVIEW: SOAP AND BUBBLES (8) is a very speedy mare who should appreciate the small field and drop back from the Vicbred Super Series four-year-old mares’ series where she ran well to finish midfield in the final behind The Art Of Success. Before that, she smoked home from a mile back to be beaten just 6.2m by SOHO DARKNSTORMY (5) in a race that saw WORDS (7) finish a close-up third after settling much closer in transit. The latter ran well for third in a hot race behind Cigano and Wicked Confession last week but the task is hard here from out wide, SOHO DARKNSTORMY (5) looks the likely early leader and did win over the track and trip on August 29 while beating key rivals, while CLYMENUS (4) hasn’t had much luck his last two but had been ready to win before that with three-straight runner-up placings. NSW visitor IMA BOXA (6) galloped out of play first-up at Wagga but looks to have good ability, while MITZI SAID (2) and WITH IN REASON (3) can also figure prominently. BACK: SOAP AND BUBBLES (8) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SOAP AND BUBBLES (8), WORDS (7), SOHO DARKNSTORMY (5), CLYMENUS (4)

OVERVIEW: BIZZNESS CLASS (3) has had just the one win from his 25 ventures to Melton, but I’ll jump in his corner in a race where he should lob handy in the small field and appreciate what is likely to be a genuine tempo. Last time, he settled three fence and hit the line nicely for third behind Mount Barker Boy in a sizzling last half, and had been cruelled by bad gates in his two prior starts. He always finishes off his races and I’m hoping he can finally get back into the winner’s stall here at HQ. HITTHEROADJACK (7) led from wide on the front row at Melton on September 25 and bolted in so must be respected if he finds the top again, KOSIMO (1) is getting right back in grade, draws well and did close off nicely last weekend at Geelong for third behind Ollies The Boss, while NEATNTIDY (4) is a speedy starter who led and won first-up at Mildura and would be a big player if able to cross down to the pegs. Noting a small share in TIMBIMBOO (2), who was just fair first-up behind HITTHEROADJACK (7) but is open to improvement after surgery and a long break. They can all win without surprising. SELECTIONS: BIZZNESS CLASS (3), HITTHEROADJACK (7), KOSIMO (1), NEATNTIDY (4)

OVERVIEW: ARZALI ROCKSTAR (3) was massive in defeat last Friday at Melton when trapped parked and only grabbed late by Feel The Rein. She ran a couple of great races despite being outclassed in the Vicbred Super Series heats and semis to reach the Group 1 final, where she was well beaten. She then went to Charlton as a $1.50 favourite, but dropped out severely and was found to have a slow recovery by vets. This looks suitable. STEEL MIKI (6) was a very impressive first-up winner when coming from off the speed to run down favourite Miss Adi at Ballarat on September 23. He won his maiden at Swan Hill before that back in late March and looks a good chance of making it three on end here. DON CRUNCH (7) has a sticky gate but is a very promising type for Tori Hutchins who brings solid Mildura form to town, LE GASTON (4) can give a sight if he’s able to work across and find the front, THE SPARKLER (8) has won two of six for David Barbetti and is a chance, as is OUR PINUP GIRL (5), who came from a mile back to win at big odds at Ballarat last week. SELECTIONS: ARZALI ROCKSTAR (3), STEEL MIKI (6), DON CRUNCH (7), LE GASTON (4)

OVERVIEW: SWEET FLORABEL (6) has already been first past the post but lost that race on protest back on August 28, and gets another chance to break her maiden in the last of 10 at Melton. She galloped out of play last time, but her two prior runs were very good despite doing things wrong. CAPTAIN HANK (1) showed good speed to lead and run along on debut, and if he settles a bit better he can win, SMOKEN HEAVEN (2) led and was only grabbed late in that race SWEET FLORABEL (6) lost on protest, while SONOFPLATINUM (4) broke on debut but was in the market there and heads the other chances. BACK: SWEET FLORABEL (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SWEET FLORABEL (6), CAPTAIN HANK (1), SMOKEN HEAVEN (2), SONOFPLATINUM (4) 10-UNIT GAME PLAN R1 #6 LOLLY – 2 units (win) R3 #10 HANDLER – 0.5 units (each-way) R6 #6 THUNDERFIRE – 3 units (win) R7 #8 SOAP AND BUBBLES – 2 units (win) R10 #6 SWEET FLORABEL – 2 units (win) EARLY QUADDIE 5,6/1,5,6,8,9/3,4,7,8,10/2,6,7,8,10,11 QUADDIE 1,2,4,8,10/3,6,9/4,5,7,8/1,3,4,7 Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW: FIGHTER COMMAND (2) has been awesome coming from off speed to win in two of three runs since returning from an Inter Dominion campaign in Queensland, where he claimed a heat and finished midfield in the final. He’s a horse right at the top of his game at the moment, and he’s the horse they have to beat. SIR JIMMY (6) was good from four back the fence in the Geelong Cup last weekend, beat all bar Catch A Wave prior and is going very well this campaign, OUR SUNSET DELIGHT (3) brings NSW form to Victoria but it’s very good in weaker grade, while BULLETPROOF BOY (10) won a third Smoken Up Sprint by beating Leap To Fame at huge odds in this race last year, and while he was very plain in the Geelong Cup last weekend from the fence, he’s too good to not give another chance. SELECTIONS: FIGHTER COMMAND (2), SIR JIMMY (6), OUR SUNSET DELIGHT (3), BULLETPROOF BOY (10)

OVERVIEW: Opening heat of the Victoria Derby where CARDIGAN DAN (2) draws to advantage for Team Stewart, who has four runners in the race. He ran a bottler with red-hot closing sectionals in a semi-final of the Vicbred Super Series before leading and being worn down by ENJOY LIFE (9) in the final. He’s sure to run well, but I’ll side with stablemate ENJOY LIFE (9). He has won nine of 10 career starts – including the Group 1 Vicbred final at his last appearance – and there’s a scenario where he quickly moves forward over the long trip to find the top. Either way, he draws for a good run and has only ever been beaten once from 10 starts. He might be too classy. SOHO CHARMER (6) sat parked to win a heat of the Vicbreds at Kilmore before galloping and ruining his hopes in the semis. He is a good horse and can threaten, while MOUNT BARKER BOY (7) ran well through the Vicbred series despite finishing last in the final and rounded up inferior rivals with a dazzling turn of speed at Melton last Friday. He looks to be a horse really maturing as the season wears on. SELECTIONS: ENJOY LIFE (9), CARDIGAN DAN (2), SOHO CHARMER (6), MOUNT BARKER BOY (7)

OVERVIEW: SOHO TRUMP (2) led and beat home BROOKLYN DAN (1) at Melton on September 26, but was entitled to do so given the barrier draw advantage and easy trip in front. In heat two of the Victoria Derby, BROOKLYN DAN (1) gets the ace gate and has the chance to overturn the result. He won a qualifier then finished a close-up fifth in the Group 1 Queensland Derby at Albion Park during July before a break and he’s a good horse who might be too slick. SOHO TRUMP (2) put in a poor run to miss the Vicbred final, but dominated the consolation and then that race last time out. He probably needs to cross to the fence at the start to win, though. LUVTOBEUPTOME (9) ran so well from off the fence in the Vicbred final and then thrashed inferior rivals in the Mildura Guineas last time out, while BETTORLEFTALONE (8) draws to get a nice trip and was a gallant second to The Final Dance at Geelong last weekend. BACK: BROOKLYN DAN (1) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: BROOKLYN DAN (1), SOHO TRUMP (2), LUVTOBEUPTOME (9), BETTORLEFTALONE (8)

OVERVIEW: NSW visitors NYMBAL (5) and PALLADIUM (1) look the key players here in heat three of the Victoria Derby, with the former narrowly favoured. Kerryann and Robbie Morris’ star youngster was badly held up in the Carousel Final last time out at Menangle and still managed to get clear late and run down PALLADIUM (1), who had controlled things at the top. It was a super performance. The two also clashed in the Group 1 Queensland Derby back in July, and while PALLADIUM (1) sat parked to score, NYMBAL (5) was very unlucky all the way to the line and arguably should have won. I think one of the two will prevail here. Other hopes are headed by SOHO PIASTRI (8), who was a big winner of the Vicbred Bronze consolation before kicking clear and being run down late by Pick Up Elvis a fortnight ago, and the Emma Stewart duo of SEASIDE BOY (7) and DYNAMITEDAN (9). BACK: NYMBAL (5) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: NYMBAL (5), PALLADIUM (1), SOHO PIASTRI (8), SEASIDE BOY (7)

OVERVIEW: Great edition of the VL Dullard Trotters Cup and I’m looking to JILLIBY DREAMLOVER (3), who I think can cross early and control the race from the top. She was well beaten by GATESYS GEM (2) in a heat and Group 1 final of the Vicbred Super Series for four-year-old trotting mares recently, but drew on the back line where she wasn’t able to use her blistering gate speed. On the fence, she’s a very good trotter who won two big features in Queensland during winter before galloping late and dropping out of the Inter Dominion Grand Final. HOPPY (9) had the perfect trip and sprinted past subsequent McNamara Memorial Trotters Cup winner Imperial Monarch to score a fortnight ago while beating LOVEMETO (7), who battled to get into things over the sprint trip from a bad gate first-up. He can certainly win back up over 2240m second-up. GATESYS GEM (2) is favourite after winning the Vicbred final and should be leader or leader’s back here, while GOTFEELINGSYOUKNOW (6) is the other key hope and returns after a runner-up placing in the Inter Dom decider behind Gus. SELECTIONS: JILLIBY DREAMLOVER (3), HOPPY (9), LOVEMETO (7), GATESYS GEM (2)

OVERVIEW: MISTER DEVEREAUX (1) has been well supported in early betting for this Group 1 Need For Speed Prince Final and I can see why. He ran very well for third despite being held up by a wayward UNCLAD (8) in the heat behind MUNNY THE MUNSTER (7) and had been exceptional cutting ground off leading three-year-old Pastor Dunbar in a qualifier of the Vicbred series prior to that. He was down-the-track in the Group 1 showdown, but draw the pole here, I fancy his chances of running a great race. MUNNY THE MUNSTER (7) won that aforementioned heat thanks to a lovely drive by Stacey Towers and he’s a leading chance despite the wide gate, KYVALLEY RAY (5) is a multiple Group 1 winner in New Zealand who galloped his way out of contention in the other heat but must be respected back to his best behaviour, while THE PREACHER (4) looks the likely early leader and should run well alongside UNCLAD (8), who looked gone in the qualifier but rallied late and finished only 1.9m from MUNNY THE MUNSTER (7) in what was a quirky but good effort. BACK: MISTER DEVEREAUX (1) – 2 units (each-way) SELECTIONS: MISTER DEVEREAUX (1), MUNNY THE MUNSTER (7), THE PREACHER (4), UNCLAD (8)

OVERVIEW: HALLEBESOFINE (7) was beaten as a short-priced favourite in the one and only heat of the Need For Speed Princess series at Melton on September 25, but it was a massive run in defeat and she’s the obvious favourite here despite the wide gate. In a race ultimately won by outsider AMIRA (6) – who scooted home best from well back on the fence – HALLEBESOFINE (7) worked hard early before letting JILLIBY AURA (2) find the top, and then sat parked to her in the last lap before only going down in the shadows of the post. JILLIBY AURA (2) dropped out sharply late to be beaten into eighth but draws for an easier lead here and is the danger, while ALDEBARAN ADA (4), HARPERSEVEN (5) and winner AMIRA (6) all ran well and are probably the other leading hopes. SELECTIONS: HALLEBESOFINE (7), JILLIBY AURA (2), ALDEBARAN ADA (4), HARPERSEVEN (5)

OVERVIEW: RIPPLES (7) is a classy filly from the Luke McCarthy barn who draws awkwardly here but has the class and lines up following a hit-and-run New Zealand mission where she ran well in a race for third in Auckland on September 25. Before that, she won the South East Oaks and Group 1 Queensland Oaks at Albion Park through July. WILLOWS GIRL (2) draws to find the pegs and was very good first-up from a break when beating the consistent SWEET IRISH LOCH (5) and TACTICALLY PERFECT (8) in the Gold Chalice first-up from a break, PRE EMINANT (6) ran really well for runner-up placings behind star stablemate Bettor Beach through the recent Vicbred Super Series, while DELIZIOSO (1) just missed in a photo at Shepparton on September 29 in what was her first outing in nearly a year and she can finish forward from the good gate. SELECTIONS: RIPPLES (7), WILLOWS GIRL (2), PRE EMINANT (6), DELIZIOSO (1)

OVERVIEW: BETTOR BEACH (2) was absolutely breathtaking through the recent Vicbred Super Series where she made a clean-sweep of her heat, semi-final and the Group 1 final, and she looks near impossible to run down if she works to the front as expected. She’s very good and deserves to be at the short quote. Former Kiwi THE QUEENS GAMBIT (8) has had three starts for master trainer Jason Grimson for two big wins and a good closing third to star colt Loucasso last time out. There’s good wraps on her and she’s fancied for second. RACHELS LEGACY (4) crossed BETTOR BEACH (2) in the Vicbred final and could fill a minor placing if that was the case again, while MY BETTOR HALF (3) is a handy filly from the Emma Stewart barn who ran well through the Vicbred series despite being no match for her stablemate. ULE HOOF OIL PACE I GOT CHILLS (11) added to a long string of wins and placings when he led and dug deep to get home last week, his third success from his last four outings here. The wide draw presents a challenge but he is going well enough to overcome it. VAN BASTEN (1) has been coming from much wider barriers of late and did manage a win here three back. Should get every chance from the ace draw. ULTIMATE CRUZA (3) was far from disgraced from a wide draw last week and had won two of his previous four outings. He is better served by this barrier. BUZZ BOMB (6) draws wider and rises in grade but was good when leading throughout at this circuit and distance last time. MAGIC JOE (8) deserves respect after winning from this barrier at Wagga last start.

BESTINBEDS.COM.AU PACE ENJABONARLO (4) worked to the front from this barrier then dug deep for a narrow win in a Breeders Challenge heat at Bathurst last start. Led from wider and stuck on when runner-up here prior. Should go forward and will be close to his peak now. WICKED WIZARD (10) made it three wins from his past five starts at this venue when he led and cruised home last week. May need a bit of luck negotiating a very wide starting position but the form is hard to knock. NUGGET ROGERS (1) didn't do a bad job when he raced parked but boxed on last time and went close when runner-up here prior. Draws to get the favours. FOREVER ONTHE PUNT (7) made a winning start for Brad Hewitt last week. Draws wider but has yet to miss a place when second-up.

LLOWALONG FARMS PACE VINCENZO (1) has been racing well from wide barriers of late, drawing deepest and racing three wide without cover before fighting on well to place here last week. Ticking along well and is much better served by the ace draw so can break through. Manners let ROCKNROLL COWBOY (7) down last week but he had been going very well prior, kicking off his campaign with back-to-back wins at this circuit and distance. If on his game he can bounce back. KEAYANG VIPER (5) is a progressive Victorian mare who took her record to five from seven when scoring at Terang last start. Has the pace to push forward so could measure up. MAC BON (4) has been coming from wider barriers of late and did manage a fourth over this distance two back. A better draw gives him the chance to find his best. MCWIZARD (6) can feature again after placing from a similar draw last week.

BE GOOD JOHNNY FFA DANGEROUS (10) looks a standout here. He came from this barrier to win by more than 5m when resuming at this circuit and distance a fortnight ago, his first hitout since July's Inter Dominion series. He should only be better for that outing and looks a class above these. DESSIE GEE (8) was far from disgraced when 6m behind Dangerous last start and was runner-up at this circuit and distance prior. Draws wider but is ticking along well. SERG BLANCO (1) hasn't performed to market expectations in two outings for Jason Grimson but has come from wider barriers each time. The ace draw gives him the chance to show his best. CAPTAIN BELLASARIO (6) has first four claims off a placing behind the flying Captains Knock two back.

CLUB MENANGLE FRITH STAKES (LISTED CLASSIC) LUX AETERNA (8) was very good against a top field last week, finishing fourth to Captains Mistress. Draws wider but will enjoy the return to her own sex and was racing well prior with a string of wins and placings including a victory in the Norms Daughter Stakes from the outside barrier. WICKED CONFESSION (3) bumped into a smart one when runner-up at Melton last week and placed in the Vicbred Super Series 4M Final prior. Scored a win and placed in the Queen Elizabeth II Mile in her last Sydney raid. Big chance from a good draw. GUNNA RELOAD (7) makes her first appearance since a second to Dangerous at Wagga in May. Owns a good fresh record and strikes at 50 per cent at this circuit and distance. GOLLY GEE FELLAS (6) will enjoy the return to mares grade having recorded a dominant win at this circuit and distance last month. IDEAL MOTH (1) has joined Jason Grimson since she won at Kilmore last month. Keep safe from the ace draw.

YABBY DAM FARMS 2YO COLTS AND GELDINGS FINAL Unbeaten Victorian VERBICI (1) stretched his perfect record to seven when he drew on the back row and raced parked before drawing clear to take out the G1 Vicbred Super Series Final by close to 9m at Melton last start. That was four weeks ago but he was kept up to the mark with a trial. Has won here before and the ace draw gives him every chance to continue on his winning way. CHIEF KENNY (2) resumes off a string of seconds at this circuit and distance, the last of them coming in the 2YO Trot NSW Final in July. Draws well and has been readied with three trials, winning the last two. KEAYANG MARCUS (6) has trialled since his fresh placing at Ballarat so should have come on and is lightly raced with upside. ORLANDO VEYRON (3) placed behind Verbici in the Vicbred final last start. Draws well and won his lone try at this distance so include.

YABBY DAM FARMS 2YO FILLIES FINAL Two Victorian fillies on debut for the Lee stable look to hold the key to this. JILLIBY CONNECTION (6) is a daughter of Classic Connection and has shown talent in winning her last two trials. Draws a little wide but is sure to be well-educated as is Bold Eagle filly KEAYANG ZABRINA (1), who is a half sister to wonder mare Keayang Zahara. Runner-up to Jilliby Connection in her latest trial but she does get the advantage of the inside draw. INTHE NORTY CORNER (8) cops the outside barrier but was good when a close second on debut at Ballarat. Should be improved by the hitout and that experience edge could prove helpful. LALI (3) is a locally-trained filly who has been solid in her trials at this circuit and draws well enough to be competitive.

CONDELL PARK PRODUCE TROTTERS MOBILE Hard to knock the form of CORMORAN STRIKE (5) who added to a series of wins and placings when he came from a 10m handicap for second in the Menangle Parks Trotters Cup last time. Owns a good record at the mile so the distance drop should suit. TORO STRIDE (8) is first up since he came from a similar barrier to this for a 1.6m third in July's Inter Dominion Final at Albion Park. Two-time fresh winner who has been readied with two trials. ZENITH STRIDE (2) won here when returning off a very long layoff then led and stuck on for a fourth last time, both from wider barriers than this. Kept up to the mark with a trial win and can take advantage of this low draw. PESCO POLLO (6) should enjoy the drop to the mile having won five of the eight times he has raced over the distance here. BEST BETS:
#4 Enjabonarlo – At his peak now and draws to go forward.

B T CAPTIVATE (10) has a tough draw to overcome tonight after he defeated BAY LA VILLE by a head last start. He has won two of his last four starts and he looks too classy for this field tonight even with the tricky draw. TWIN CONNECTION (3) will need a little luck from the draw but if he can find the lead he will run a strong race out in front. KEILAH (7) and WHATA OPTIMIST (1) are also chances.

NOT VICIOUS (5) didn’t run a bad race last start when she faced the breeze and ended up being defeated by 7.3 metres behind the winner in a much tougher race. Tonight looks easier for her and she should enjoy a track like Port Pirie. She will be hard to beat. DARLINGTON (2) is a well bred filly who has only had the one start. She joins the Mick Darling stable tonight and has performed well in trials here at Port Pirie. It may pay to watch her market moves. SEASIDE SHOW (8) and WHENIMREADY (3) are also chances.

CEE CEE LOU (4) did a tonne of work last start to run second behind HEEZ A VIBE. He looks like a strong chance tonight in this sort of race. PLACES YOU DONT (2), IM ALL BUSINESS (3) and DON ARTHUR (5) are all big chances in what is a very even race.

ROCKIN GEMMA (8) was extremely impressive last start when she defeated ASHANTE PRINCE by 9.7 metres. She is racing extremely well at the moment and she looks like a massive chance in this sort of race. REACH THE PEAK (9) is another who is racing well. He was narrowly beaten last start at Globe Derby after a win prior to that. He is a massive chance tonight. CHASE THE STARS (4) and MIKIS BEAUTY (3) are also chances in what is a very even race.

CLASSIC LINE (5) has been working back up to a race like this. His recent form hasn’t been great but he did improve at Globe Derby last start when he ran second behind HEZROCKINROYALTY. He is a big chance tonight. REPELLING (2) and ALORA (3) have both lacked consistency, but when they have won recently it has been emphatic. They are both major chances tonight. NAROBI (7) is also a massive chance if she can get some luck.

TUFFASNAILS (7) ran third last start when he defeated DELIGHTFUL DREAM by 8.5 metres. He was a massive winner the start prior to that when he won by 37.6 metres in a Monday race. Tonight looks easier for him compared to last start and he should be hard to beat. ALOHA PRINCESS (8) looks like the main danger. Tonight looks easier for her as well and she is going to be a big threat. BUSTNLOOSE (1) and WOODVILLE FLYER (4) are also chances.

SHIREEN (3) will love this distance and she usually loves racing here at Port Pirie. She is well drawn and looks ready to bounce back into the winners list. ITZ BLACKJACK (7), ASHANTE PRINCE (4) and DIDMESELFAMISCHIEF (2) are also chances.

LIGHTNING BLING (2) was impressive on Wednesday at Globe Derby when he defeated PARISIAN BANDIT by 2.1 metres. He is a big threat again tonight in a similar race. BURNING HOT (1) hasn’t won a race for a while but he does look like a big threat from the inside draw. MEET ME AT THE BEACH (7) also looks like a major chance from the second row draw. She has won three of her last four starts. ROLL WITH MUSTARD (5) looks the next best.

HILLTOP CRUNCH (3) returns from a few months off after showing signs of improvement at the trials recently. He looks like the one to beat tonight. MYA QUICK (1) and CHIARA MARA (2) are also worth consideration. FARROH GODDESS (4) looks the next best.
